messages.author: 6e15de0134e98c08
messages.subject: Re: Binned data & GOF tests
parts:
Dear Ryan, list,

The two GOF tests you mention can only be computed on exact distances,=20
therefore you don't see them reported in the output once you have binned=20
the data.

But more importantly, you can not use AIC to compare models that are fit=20
to different data. This includes for example different truncation=20
distances or different cut points for binning the data. So the fact that=20
the AIC's are higher for binned than non binned models does not mean the=20
fit is worst, it just means you cannot compare them using AIC.

Hope this helps,

Tiago
